newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst signs research deal with Symyx.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst signs research deal with Symyx.

text.p: Germany's largest chemicals and drugs group, Hoechst AG said on Wednesday that it had entered into a long-term research collaboration with Symyx Technologies of California.

Under the terms of the five-year partnership, Symyx will receive a minimum of $10 million in research payments over the fitst two years, with up to $43 million in research payments over the full five-year period, Hoechst said in a statement.

"In the first major research collaboration in this discipline, Symyx and Hoechst will apply cambinatorial chemistry to the discovery and developments of new materials, especially catalysts, for the chemicals industry," it said.
